title: 墨烟试装升级｜日常基线、遮挡换装与黑白合流
source_title: 墨烟造型试穿｜T恤到黑白礼服合流
summary: 先以日常全身造型建立一名明确成年人物，再让同一条可追踪流体载体反复遮挡并揭示受控造型变化；服装密度从休闲逐级升至礼服，中段用面部近景重新核验身份，结尾让两种载体分支合流为一套清楚的双色英雄造型。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change. + Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography. + Escalate styling in ordered density levels from practical clothing to tailored and sculptural looks without changing every visual channel at once. + Insert one bounded portrait checkpoint that re-verifies stable identity anchors before the terminal full-body phase. + Split the carrier into two visibly distinct branches, then recombine them into one stable two-part hero design and hold the completed result.
recommended_input: 象牙色无影棚内，一名明确成年栗发展览设计师穿沙色工具连体服正面站立；椭圆脸、齐肩卷发与修长比例稳定，一条宽钴蓝织物带从画面左侧进入，并始终作为唯一换装载体。；同一织物带只增加一条铜色边缘，并在人物后方扩成清楚空间层；依次揭示原创钴蓝雕塑晚装与铜色点缀礼服，只提升轮廓体积，不改变成年身份和影棚轴线。；载体分成钴蓝与铜色两支，两支都必须围绕同一成年人连续可追踪；它们在中心合流并形成一套原创非对称钴蓝铜色英雄套装。织物带清场，完整全身结果停留一秒，不出现标志和文字。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change.
Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography.
Insert one bounded portrait checkpoint that re-verifies stable identity anchors before the terminal full-body phase.
Split the carrier into two visibly distinct branches, then recombine them into one stable two-part hero design and hold the completed result.
